# 研发规范手册

后端的编码、接口和数据库规范

Category: 研发规范

When: 写后端代码、设计接口或者改表结构时

The documents of this knowledge base are on this computer, in:

```text
~/.acme/knowledge/eng-handbook/
```

Search them (for example with `grep -rn` or `rg`) and read the files that match before you answer or change anything they cover. Say which file each piece of guidance comes from. Do not copy them anywhere else.

If the directory is missing or empty, the person has not fetched it yet: ask them to run `acme sync`.
